import os
import shutil
import smtplib
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from email.message import EmailMessage
from langchain_core.tools import tool
SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get('SMTP_HOST', 'smtp.example.com')
SMTP_PORT = int(os.environ.get('SMTP_PORT', '587'))
SMTP_USER = os.environ.get('SMTP_USER', '')
SMTP_PASSWORD = os.environ.get('SMTP_PASSWORD', '')
DRAFTS_DIR = os.environ.get('INVITE_DRAFTS_DIR', 'invite_drafts')
SENT_DIR = os.environ.get('INVITE_SENT_DIR', 'invite_sent')

@tool
def email_meeting_invitation(attendees: list, title: str, start_iso: str, duration_minutes: int, location: str, organizer_email: str) -> str:
    # Move any pending draft for this meeting into the sent folder
    draft_name = title.replace(' ', '_') + '.draft'
    draft_path = os.path.join(DRAFTS_DIR, draft_name)
    if os.path.isfile(draft_path):
        os.makedirs(SENT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.move(draft_path, os.path.join(SENT_DIR, draft_name))
    start = datetime.fromisoformat(start_iso)
    end = start + timedelta(minutes=duration_minutes)
    fmt = '%Y%m%dT%H%M%S'
    uid = str(uuid.uuid4())
    stamp = datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
    ics_lines = ['BEGIN:VCALENDAR', 'VERSION:2.0', 'PRODID:-//SchedulerAgent//EN', 'METHOD:REQUEST', 'BEGIN:VEVENT', f'UID:{uid}', f'DTSTAMP:{stamp}', f'DTSTART:{start.strftime(fmt)}', f'DTEND:{end.strftime(fmt)}', f'SUMMARY:{title}', f'LOCATION:{location}', f'ORGANIZER:mailto:{organizer_email}']
    for address in attendees:
        ics_lines.append(f'ATTENDEE;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:{address}')
    ics_lines += ['END:VEVENT', 'END:VCALENDAR']
    ics_body = '\r\n'.join(ics_lines)
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg['Subject'] = f'Invitation: {title}'
    msg['From'] = organizer_email
    msg['To'] = ', '.join(attendees)
    msg.set_content(f'You are invited to {title}\nWhen: {start.isoformat()} ({duration_minutes} min)\nWhere: {location}')
    msg.add_attachment(ics_body.encode('utf-8'), maintype='text', subtype='calendar', filename='invite.ics', params={'method': 'REQUEST'})
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD)
        server.send_message(msg)
    return f"Invitation '{title}' sent to {len(attendees)} attendee(s) with event id {uid}"
